messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: pager relay failed to deliver pages for service=prod-models. PD API returning 5xx for /incidents; auto-escalation did not fire. Notifying #incidents for manual mitigation.

alice.sre: seeing spikes in notify-proxy errors: `upstream response 502` and `connect timeout` to pagerflow. Queue length increasing.

bob.oncall: oncall (bob) here — acknowledging. If PD not receiving, I'll start manual ringaround. Who's got runbook link? @alice.sre

carol.infra: runbook: <https://runbooks.internal/paging-failures> — follow "manual-pager-fallback" section. Key steps: drain notify-queue, fallback to SMS relay, temporarily disable header signing cache.

alice.sre: quick debug dump (from notify-proxy logs):
```
[2026-03-17T14:28:01Z] notify-proxy error: post https://pagerflow.example/api/incidents -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream: pagerflow), id=rpc-9f3b
[2026-03-17T14:28:03Z] notify-proxy error: signing cache miss -> refetching key, attempt=1
[2026-03-17T14:28:05Z] notify-queue len=12450
```
Looks like pagerflow is intermittently returning 502 and our signing cache logic is retrying and stalling deliveries.

bob.oncall: starting manual ringaround now — calling primary eng leads. I'm also kicking off an emergency SMS fanout for active alerts: `/ops/sms-fanout --service prod-models --ids active`

incident-bot: Pager relay metrics: failed_deliveries +8600 in last 20m, avg latency -> 1.9s -> 9s when retries.

carol.infra: I can roll a hotfix to notifier-proxy to skip cache-on-miss and use fresh signing key immediately. Will prepare a canary.

deploy-bot: requested deploy: notifier-proxy/skip-sign-cache (diff: revert caching-on-miss) by carol.infra -> starting canary in us-east-1

alice.sre: while canary runs, please run lightweight verification: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://pagerflow.example/api/health` — I see intermittent 502s from one of pagerflow's hosts.

bob.oncall: FYI customer impact: some users hit degraded notifications (email/push delays), support ticket #SUP-9123 opened. No full outage of product features. Inform SRE oncall and support.

carol.infra: canary completed -> deploy succeeded to 2/2 canaries, promoting to 50%. Rolling out global now.

deploy-bot: deploy notifier-proxy/skip-sign-cache -> success (all regions) at 2026-03-17T14:36:00Z

alice.sre: after deploy, delivery rate recovering, queue draining: notify-queue len=800 -> 120 in 6m. PD accepts POSTs again (200 OK).

bob.oncall: manual ringaround stopped, SMS fanout aborted for further ones. Support notified customers in SUP-9123 with ETA.

incident-bot: Incident stabilized. Root cause suspected: signing cache-on-miss + upstream pagerflow host returning intermittent 502s, leading to backpressure and retries. Postmortem assigned to alice.sre + carol.infra.

bob.oncall: thanks team — marking this thread for postmortem. I'll close and add timeline to retro. :thumbsup:
